gap: Ours is a synthetic HTML mock, the bar is a real app capture. Wave's accounting hero shows genuine product chrome (checkboxes, Filter/Sort/Auto-updates pills, ruled table, dated rows with account names, a cursor arrow) inside a navy rounded device frame, so the right-edge crop reads as deliberate and the software reads as real. Our dashboard has no frame and no ground shadow, so it floats and its bleed off the top and right reads as an accident: the STAFF ON LEAVE tile is sliced in half, the rightmost chart bars are amputated mid-column and the last month label is cut to 'Ju'. Our chart is flat rounded rectangles with no axis or values, and the 'Currency billing / Any' chip tails onto blank beige rather than any UI element. Worst on mobile: our fold shows zero product, just the top sliver of the navy header plus one half-cut chip, while the bar puts a fully framed, legible Transactions table above the mobile fold. We only beat Wave's own home hero, which is blurred to illegibility; we lose to its accounting hero on authenticity, crop discipline and mobile presence.
